terminals.name: api
terminals.description: Express API + funnel pipeline on http://localhost:3000 (rebuilds with esbuild, then serves /api/*).
terminals.command: cd artifacts/api-server && DATABASE_URL='postgres://ubuntu@127.0.0.1:5432/crypsor' PORT=3000 pnpm run dev

terminals.name: web
terminals.description: Crypsor desk (Vite dev server) on http://localhost:5173, proxying API calls to http://localhost:3000.
terminals.command: cd artifacts/crypsor && PORT=5173 VITE_API_URL='http://localhost:3000' pnpm run dev
